Exact source: Silent Hill4: The Room (2004), final OUTSIDE ROOM302 route, FIRST FLOOR corridor outside chained Superintendent Room105, as in the attached native screenshot. This is the late red altered apartment world, not the normal apartment hallway and not Room302 interior. Strict observed identity: heavily mottled rust-red walls, red/dark worn floorboards or broad rectangular floor panels, very tall desaturated green-gray door on the right half with small mesh upper panel and lower inset panels, battered door frame, several long chains fixed to the door and the wall at diagonal angles, tiny105 door number plate and slanted superintendent sign. Keep that same door and chains, with no invented adjacent numbered door or furniture. Small distant corridor continuation only at extremeleft as observed. No hanging person, statue, Henry, Eileen, weapon or other actor. Reconstruct the referenced wall bay in a wide nearly straight-on side-facing view, door fully visible, wall/floor junction y≈63%, and lower37% continuous level dark-red floor clear for a horizontal fight-foot line at y82.5%. All chains remain on rear wall above y67%, never hanging over the combat lane. Avoid deep first-person corridor, dramatic forced perspective and wide hall redesign. Low dim red-brown original-game illumination and steel-gray door contrast. No UI, captions, HUD, logos, readable added text or border. Any source door plate is tiny and unobtrusive. Fully opaque to all edges, one scene, no montage. Native source-guided versus camera adaptation, no claim of exact replica.
